language.name: English
language.label: Language
toggle.capturing: Press a key, a key combination or controller buttons, then release (click again to cancel)
toggle.help: Examples: F5, Ctrl+F5, Pad.BACK, Pad.LB+Pad.RB. Applied immediately and saved to config.json.
controller.axes: L stick ({lx}, {ly})  R stick ({rx}, {ry})  LT {lt}  RT {rt}
output.error.plugin: Failed to create the virtual controller ({error})
output.error.ready: The virtual controller did not become ready ({error})
output.passthrough_hint: Input from the physical controller is forwarded to the virtual one. If the game sees both, hide the physical controller with HidHide.
keymap.hint: Choose the key each controller input presses, matching the game's keyboard settings. Inputs without a key are not sent; inputs sharing a key hold it while any of them is held. The Yakumo preset leaves Y unassigned because Yakumo's △ is on the mouse.
target.label: Send keys to:
target.windowless: {exe} (PID {pids}) has no window to send keys to
target.pid_gone: PID {pid} has exited; sending to the other {exe} processes
target.hint: Keys are posted to the process's windows, so it does not need focus. Programs that read the keyboard via DirectInput or raw input may ignore them; use "Active window" for those. An elevated process needs PadTurbo to run as administrator too.
turbo.capture: Add buttons pressed on the controller
turbo.capture_hint: Press the buttons to turbo on your controller (click again to finish)
turbo.rate: Each press lasts {press} ms / about {rate} presses per second
turbo.hold: Only while the button is held
record.description: Records controller input (buttons, triggers and sticks) with its timing.
record.description2: When stopped, the macro is saved to macro.json and can be looped with "Play macro".
play.description: Plays the recorded macro repeatedly until stopped.
check.no_macro: No macro recorded yet. Run "Record macro" first
check.no_target: Select the process to send keys to
run.hint: {key} Start/Stop (works while the game is active)
run.config_tip: Change it in the "Start/Stop key" section above (saved to config.json).
log.bad_config: config.json could not be read ({error}); using {key}
